protocol.starting_position: Participant stands upright and motionless with both feet fully supported on the qualified force acquisition, before initiating one jump.
protocol.arm_hand_condition: Both hands remain on the hips throughout the trial; this condition is practitioner- or protocol-confirmed and is not inferred from force alone.
protocol.loading_condition: Unloaded: no external load is carried or held. In this protocol, accepted quiet-standing vertical force is the participant body-weight force and is also the system-weight baseline for net force.
protocol.countermovement_requirement: One deliberate downward countermovement is followed by upward propulsion and takeoff. No pause, step, preliminary jump, or second jump is allowed in the scored interval.
protocol.pre_movement_behavior: The participant remains quiet during the accepted one-second standing window, with no voluntary rocking, stepping, or unloading before movement onset.
exclusion_criteria: hands not on hips or arm swing
step, foot repositioning, partial-foot contact, or one foot leaving before takeoff
more than one countermovement or more than one landing in the scored interval
missing, nonfinite, irregular, or unsupported qualified input
no valid quiet-standing window or required event
protocol.limitation: Force-time data cannot establish hands-on-hips, external load, or the absence of a preparatory movement; those conditions require upstream protocol evidence or practitioner review.

eligible_input.input_boundary: Only qualified CanonicalAcquisition and ConfigurationResolution products are accepted. The processor does not parse raw CSV, TSV, JSON, or vendor files.
eligible_input.required_timebase: finite, strictly increasing, uniform timestamps with explicit qualified rate
eligible_input.single_total_fz_rule: Use the one qualified total vertical-force channel as F_vertical_N.
eligible_input.dual_independent_fz_rule: For each synchronized sample index i, form F_vertical_N[i] = Fz_left_N[i] + Fz_right_N[i]. Preserve both channels and their identities in the calculation trace; no asymmetry diagnosis is performed.
eligible_input.synchronization_requirement: Dual channels require explicit upstream synchronization; equal length or equal sample rate is not sufficient.
eligible_input.unsupported_input_behavior: Any other physical configuration, channel count, unresolved quantity, unresolved unit/axis/sign/timebase, or unqualified upstream state fails closed.

sample_rate_policy.rate_rule: The qualified acquisition rate must be explicitly established and at least 1000 Hz. A rate above 1000 Hz is accepted without downsampling when all other timebase requirements pass.
sample_rate_policy.rate_evidence_rule: The rate must be an upstream qualified acquisition/timebase fact; a device capability statement is not evidence of the recorded rate.
sample_rate_policy.unknown_rate_behavior: Fail with SAMPLE_RATE_UNSUPPORTED; no default is applied.
sample_rate_policy.irregular_timebase_behavior: Fail with TIMEBASE_INVALID even when a nominal rate is declared.
sample_rate_policy.missing_sample_behavior: Fail with MISSING_SAMPLE; missing values are not synthesized.
sample_rate_policy.rationale: The selected core includes impulse-derived velocity and height. Street et al. report material height error below approximately 1000 Hz for their force-platform method, while Owen et al. use a 1000 Hz criterion protocol. This is a scoped minimum for this contract, not a universal claim about every metric or device.
sample_rate_policy.limitation: Rate alone does not establish anti-aliasing, calibration, noise, or metric validity; those facts remain upstream qualification requirements.

quiet_standing.window_definition: A contiguous inclusive timestamp window with elapsed duration exactly 1.000 s, immediately preceding the movement-onset search interval.
quiet_standing.candidate_search: Enumerate eligible one-second windows by descending end sample index. Select the latest window whose samples are finite, contiguous, uniformly timed, contain no missing sample, and pass the stability rule; the first valid movement-onset run after that window must be found before the acquisition ends.
quiet_standing.stability_criterion: max(abs(F_vertical_N - mean(F_vertical_N))) <= 0.05 * abs(mean(F_vertical_N)) and (max(F_vertical_N) - min(F_vertical_N)) <= 0.10 * abs(mean(F_vertical_N)).
quiet_standing.mean_force_rule: Arithmetic mean of all total-force samples in the accepted window, accumulated in ascending sample-index order using binary64.
rejection_criteria: no ordered movement onset after the window
quiet_standing.search_tie_break: Latest ending window wins; if end indices tie, the earliest start index is used.
quiet_standing.rationale: A one-second pre-jump mean is directly supported by the criterion protocol. The exact stability bounds, zero missing-data tolerance, descending search, and exact timestamp rule are explicit engineering choices that prevent silent heuristic changes.
quiet_standing.limitation: A force-stable window can still contain an unobserved technique or protocol violation; protocol evidence remains separate.

body_system_weight.relationship_in_unloaded_protocol: body_weight_N == system_weight_N because CMJ-U-BI-HOH is unloaded and the participant is the only accepted load on the force acquisition.
body_system_weight.formula: body_weight_N = system_weight_N = arithmetic_mean(F_vertical_N over accepted quiet-standing window)
body_system_weight.dual_plate_rule: Sum left and right vertical forces sample-by-sample before calculating the mean.
body_system_weight.failure_behavior: Missing, nonfinite, zero, or negative baseline fails with BODY_WEIGHT_UNAVAILABLE; derived nonfinite or nonpositive mass fails with INVALID_MASS.
body_system_weight.precision: Binary64 internally; no rounding before mass, net force, impulse, or integration.
body_system_weight.external_load_behavior: Any loaded or supported condition is protocol-ineligible; the processor does not silently relabel system weight as body weight.

gravity.name: standard gravity
gravity.limitation: Local gravitational acceleration is not estimated; v1 uses standard gravity for reproducible reporting.

events.name: Movement onset
events.baseline: body_weight_N from the accepted quiet-standing window
events.persistence: ceil(sample_rate_hz * 0.020) consecutive samples meeting the threshold
events.search_interval: first sample after the accepted quiet-standing window through the last sample before the takeoff search result
events.sample_index_convention: event index is the first sample of the persistent run; no sample is backdated or averaged
events.time_convention: event time is the input timestamp at event index
events.return_to_baseline_behavior: Not required; later return through baseline does not change the first onset event.
events.limitation: Force-time onset is a defined operational boundary, not a claim that it equals the first joint-flexion instant.

events.name: Takeoff
events.baseline: absolute force threshold; body-weight baseline is not substituted
events.persistence: ceil(sample_rate_hz * 0.020) consecutive samples meeting the threshold
events.dual_plate_behavior: Apply the threshold to the formed total F_vertical_N; do not apply independent thresholds to left and right channels.
events.search_interval: first sample after movement onset through the last sample before landing search
events.sample_index_convention: event index is the first sample of the persistent run
events.time_convention: event time is the input timestamp at event index
events.limitation: The fixed 20 N operational threshold is scoped to v1 and is not a universal force-platform takeoff standard.

events.name: Landing
events.baseline: absolute force threshold; body-weight baseline is not substituted
events.direction: upward from near-zero force to contact force
events.persistence: ceil(sample_rate_hz * 0.020) consecutive samples meeting the threshold
events.dual_plate_behavior: Apply the threshold to the formed total F_vertical_N; preserve the two source channels without diagnosing asymmetry.
events.search_interval: first sample after takeoff_index through the last sample of the acquisition
events.sample_index_convention: event index is the first sample of the persistent run
events.time_convention: event time is the input timestamp at event index
events.limitation: A force threshold detects return to measurable plate load; it does not identify the first anatomical contact instant.

equations.vertical_force: single.total_fz: F_vertical_N[i] = Fz_total_N[i]; dual.independent_fz: F_vertical_N[i] = Fz_left_N[i] + Fz_right_N[i]
equations.sign_convention: upward vertical force, acceleration, velocity, and displacement are positive; downward is negative.
equations.units: force N, mass kg, acceleration m/s^2, velocity m/s, displacement m, impulse N*s

integration.timebase: Use qualified input timestamps; require strictly increasing uniform timestamps; do not derive or repair time from array position.
integration.reference_position: x=0 at movement onset; pre-takeoff displacement is relative to that reference.
integration.endpoint_inclusion: Integrate intervals from movement-onset index through takeoff index inclusive; each interval is counted once.
integration.accumulation_order: strict ascending interval index; no parallel reduction or reordering
integration.fma_policy: NO_REQUIRED_FUSED_OPERATION; use the stated operation sequence

impulse.net_impulse_onset_to_takeoff: integral of F_net_N from movement_onset_index through takeoff_index inclusive

metrics.name: Impulse-momentum jump height
metrics.definition: Ballistic center-of-mass rise from takeoff velocity to apex; pre-takeoff displacement is not included.
metrics.formula_source: h = v_takeoff^2 / (2*g), with v_takeoff obtained by integrating net force from movement onset to takeoff.
metrics.availability_conditions: Available when all listed dependencies are finite and the onset-to-takeoff integration preconditions pass; landing is required for a fully included trial but is not a mathematical dependency of this metric.

metrics.name: Takeoff velocity
metrics.definition: Vertical center-of-mass velocity at the takeoff event from net-force integration.
metrics.formula_source: v_takeoff = integral(a dt) from movement onset to takeoff = net_impulse / body_mass.

metrics.name: Net impulse, onset to takeoff
metrics.definition: Integrated net vertical force over the operational propulsion interval from movement onset to takeoff.
metrics.availability_conditions: Finite net-force integration over a nonempty ordered interval.

metrics.name: Body-weight force
metrics.definition: Mean unloaded quiet-standing vertical ground-reaction force used as the net-force baseline.
metrics.formula_source: mean total vertical force over accepted quiet-standing window

metrics.name: Derived body mass
metrics.definition: Mass derived from unloaded body-weight force and standard gravity.
metrics.availability_conditions: Positive finite body-weight force and positive finite fixed gravity constant.

metrics.name: Pre-takeoff displacement
metrics.definition: Integrated vertical displacement from movement onset reference to takeoff.
metrics.formula_source: x_takeoff = integral(v dt) from movement onset to takeoff
metrics.availability_conditions: Finite cumulative velocity integration with x[onset]=0.

metrics.name: Movement time to takeoff
metrics.definition: Elapsed timestamp difference from movement onset to takeoff.

metrics.name: Time in air
metrics.definition: Elapsed timestamp difference from takeoff to landing; descriptive event cross-check only.
metrics.availability_conditions: Ordered finite takeoff and landing timestamps.

excluded_metrics.name: Flight-time jump height
excluded_metrics.reason: Excluded from core; it is a distinct descriptive height definition and is not the primary impulse-momentum metric.

excluded_metrics.name: Rate of force development
excluded_metrics.reason: Excluded in v1 because derivative/filter/window choices are not frozen and reliability is metric-specific.

excluded_metrics.name: Arbitrary-window peak force
excluded_metrics.reason: Excluded because the window and filtering policy are not part of the closed core.

excluded_metrics.name: Asymmetry diagnosis
excluded_metrics.reason: Excluded; dual channels are preserved for provenance but no asymmetry conclusion is authorized.

excluded_metrics.name: Vendor-proprietary metric
excluded_metrics.reason: Excluded; vendor outputs are not scientific authority for this contract.

excluded_metrics.name: Longitudinal change
excluded_metrics.reason: Excluded; requires session/reference governance outside ML-109.

excluded_metrics.name: Clinical or diagnostic output
excluded_metrics.reason: Excluded by product scope and authority lock.

states.trigger: Upstream acquisition or configuration is unsupported, unresolved, conflicting, or not qualified.
states.future_override_policy: No v1 practitioner override; new evidence requires a new contract evaluation.

states.trigger: A required processor precondition or deterministic execution step fails.
states.future_override_policy: No silent retry or override; retain failure code and contract version.

states.trigger: A required event is absent or event ordering is invalid.
states.metric_availability_effect: Only metrics whose dependencies are satisfied may remain available with explicit state.
states.future_override_policy: No practitioner event editing in v1.

states.trigger: A non-blocking integrity finding is present while required calculations remain valid.
states.metric_availability_effect: Metrics remain available if their prerequisites pass.
states.future_override_policy: Practitioner may annotate but cannot delete the finding.

states.trigger: A metric dependency or required event is unavailable.
states.metric_availability_effect: Only the named metric is unavailable; dependent metrics are unavailable transitively.
states.future_override_policy: No imputation or silent substitution in v1.

states.trigger: Protocol, technique, or human-confirmed eligibility evidence is missing or contradictory.
states.metric_availability_effect: Mechanically calculable values may be displayed as review-only.
states.future_override_policy: Practitioner disposition is additive and attributable; it cannot rewrite source or machine findings.

states.trigger: The trial or requested metric is outside the closed protocol or metric pack.
states.metric_availability_effect: Excluded metric is never produced as a core result.
states.future_override_policy: Only a future versioned contract may add scope.

states.trigger: Qualified input, valid timebase, valid baseline, ordered required events, protocol eligibility, and all core prerequisites pass.
states.metric_availability_effect: All applicable core metrics are available.
states.future_override_policy: Human interpretation remains separate from machine inclusion.

precision_policy.storage_precision: JSON numbers representing finite binary64 results; raw intermediate arrays are not serialized into metadata.
precision_policy.serialization: UTF-8 canonical JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys, preserved array order, finite numbers only, and negative zero normalized to 0.
precision_policy.timezone: UTC for non-semantic display metadata; no wall-clock value enters calculation or semantic hash

determinism.invariant: same CanonicalAcquisition + same ConfigurationResolution + same ProcessorContract version + same MetricPack version produces the same quiet-standing result, body weight, events, calculation trace, metrics, quality state, and result hash.
determinism.replay_requirement: replay must compare semantic values and hashes, not display-rounded strings

calculation_trace.event_record: event_id, sample_index, timestamp_s, threshold, persistence_count, and source signal identity
calculation_trace.net_force_transform: Record total-force formation, baseline value, sign convention, and units; preserve dual left/right channel identities.
calculation_trace.metric_dependency_graph: Record metric IDs and direct dependency IDs without copying the high-rate signal.
calculation_trace.raw_data_policy: Do not duplicate full high-rate raw or canonical signal data into metadata.

analytical_sanity_examples.input: F_net_N = 160 N for 0.5 s and mass = 80 kg
